abstract.para: Download the packages of enabled repositories to your &rmt; server, either on a schedule or manually.

topic.para: Packages for enabled repositories are mirrored on your &rmt; server. Packages are downloaded periodically once a day. But the download can also be triggered manually at any time.
The periodic mirroring is activated by the &systemd; timer rmt-server-mirror.timer. To show its status, for example, the next running time, use systemctl status.

Jun 22 04:22:34 d31 systemd[1]: Started RMT Mirror timer.
topic.para: If the timer is not enabled or started, start it manually.
To update the mirrored packages manually, use the rmt-cli mirror command. For details, see the rmt-cli command reference.
